title: Keep single-wire Codex exit fixtures from retaining a dead second slot
outcome: For Default-profile exit and retirement fixtures, install only the Default slot or explicitly clear/assert both test slots. The opt-in single-wire helper aliases the same runtime into both homes; production runtime-id lookup removes Default first, leaving a stale ReadOnly clone and command sender. Preserve distinct two-profile witnesses.
acceptance: Exit and retirement fixtures cannot leave a dead aliased runtime or retained command sender in the second slot; meaningful lifecycle tests pass.
